theorem_title: Guarded wanted acceptance is equivalent to a true color witness
natural_language_statement:
Suppose memory stores the complete pipeline for a selected color, original length-$n$ input $x$, and strictly increasing normalized lists $A,B,C$. If the schedule is ready for exponent $k$ and $|x_i|\le n^k$, then the finite wanted scan accepts under its exact physical mass, hit, threshold, and record-count data if and only if that color has a true original 3SUM witness.

This equivalence closes correctness of the guarded physical wanted scan for one selected color of the original input.
